title: Zeus Armor Vaporizer Case
description:
The ZEUS Armor vaporizer case is the perfect companion for almost any portable vaporizer, vape or wax pen! It features a large front storage pouch, a precision custom-cut hard foam grinder slot perfect for your Zeus Bolt grinder, a pouch for the Zeus Charge and tons of room for your herbs and accessories!. Features of this case include:

Features:
Precision, custom-cut hard foam interior
Splash and shock resistant
Zips closed
Tight seal to prevent smells from escaping
ZEUS bolt grinder custom slot
Extra space for herbs, accessories and charger
Light yet extremely durable
1 Year Warranty

Package Contents
1 x ZEUS Armor Case
